plan.major: History (History and Social Science Education Option)
plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, History B.A. program page, 'History and Social Science Education' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid), Total Hours 120. This option (63-unit major) prepares students for Subject Matter Competency in Social Sciences for credentialing. All semester sums reconcile with printed Hours. 'Or' rows modeled as choice slots with code = first-listed course. Catalog spellings kept verbatim: 'Quantative' in GE Area 2. First Year Spring carries the source's editorial note verbatim ('need to take Econ 210 for 4A') alongside POL 101, which the source itself parenthetically marks as GE Area 4A — both rows kept as printed. Second Year Spring includes a genuine 2-unit 'Elective' (3+2+3+3+1+3=15 as printed). GE Area 5C Laboratory is 1 unit here, confirming the general History roadmap's 3-unit 5C on the same page is a genuine catalog inconsistency (documented on the general plan, not 'fixed'). Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
